Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.388 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Tambaur, District Sitapur.

entities.text: D.P. Act, Police Station Tambaur, District Sitapur
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant three years ago and she has now been killed for dowry.
The entire matrimonial family has been implicated because of the death.
In the postmortem report, the cause of death is shown as asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging.
there is no other injury reported in the postmortem report.

sentences.text: 4. The Counsel for the applicant argues that the applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no material on record to demonstrate that soon before the death, the victim was harassed mentally or physically in relation to the demand of dowry.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the said submissions and the fact that the applicant is the mother-in-law coupled with the fact that she has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 29.10.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicantLajjawati be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
